note: 四端（Mac / iOS / Android / 鸿蒙）启动器的「一套体验」规格。状态、文案、错误码、任务事件到界面的映射只在这里定义一次；各端只负责画，不另写一套措辞。错误码的「下一步」不在本文件里写第二份：一律指向 pack/jobs/errors.py 的 RECOVERY（口径见 README.md）。口径号 revision 改动规则见 README.md。

pack_graphics_mode.note: #389（iOS「关于本包」）与 #387（Mac 启动器画面模式）同源于 IPA 的 Info.plist，两句文案两处逐字相同；改字面必须同一次改这两个源文件。包只出直连（11-07 拆通用模式），S2AGraphicsMode 不是 direct 一律按未知。

unknown.zh-Hans: 未知（这个包没有记录画面模式）
unknown.en: Unknown (this package did not record a graphics mode)

detail.en: Copying the game files into the library.

detail.zh-Hans: 解包、改写、翻译着色器、装包，完成后即可运行。
detail.en: Unpacking, rewriting, translating shaders and bundling; the game can run when this finishes.

detail.zh-Hans: 准备完成，可以打开游戏。
detail.en: Preparation finished; the game can be launched.

detail.zh-Hans: 游戏正在运行。
detail.en: The game is running.

detail.zh-Hans: 这一步没做成，按下面那句处理后重试。
detail.en: This step did not finish; follow the line below and retry.

detail.zh-Hans: 上次准备被打断，已完成的阶段不重跑，从这里接着做。
detail.en: The last preparation was interrupted; finished stages are kept and this continues from where it stopped.

transitions.note: 游戏已在库里但没有可用密钥
进程被打断（崩溃 / 关窗 / 断电）后回到启动器
重试沿用 journal 里已完成的阶段

terminal_results.note: 任务终态，不是错误码：没有 severity / retryable，也不查 errors 表。

detail.zh-Hans: 任务已完成，使用本次交付的安装包与资源包。
detail.en: The job finished; use the installer and resource pack produced by this run.

detail.zh-Hans: 任务被取消了；需要时重新发起，已有成功产物保留。
detail.en: The job was cancelled; start it again when needed, successful artifacts are kept.

fields.stageId: 阶段机器名（pack/contracts/protocol.py STAGES 的右值）
fields.stageIndex: 第几个阶段，从 1 开始；与 stageCount 一起画阶段条
fields.total: 当前阶段总量；缺失时不画进度条，只画转圈
fields.code: 错误码，查 errors 表；终态码查 terminal_results
fields.nextAction: 下一步那句话，优先用事件里的这条（本机化后的），没有才回落到 pack/jobs/errors.py 的 RECOVERY

errors.note: 码集合 = RECOVERY 的键集合，外加 artifact_invalid（pack/targets/ios/adapter.py 抛，恢复口径在 pack/contracts/README.md）。每条只写标题 / 说明 / 严重度 / 能否重试 / 能否恢复；下一步一律由 next_action.from 指回源文件，本文件不写第二份文案。

detail.en: This environment check requires a 64-bit Windows host.

detail.en: No official Windows Metal compiler reporting a valid version was found.

detail.zh-Hans: Apple设备服务或本机驱动通道未就绪。
detail.en: The Apple device service or local driver channel is not ready.

detail.zh-Hans: 已检查的Apple移动设备服务未处于运行状态。
detail.en: The checked Apple Mobile Device Service is not running.

detail.zh-Hans: 本次查询范围内未检出足够的官方iCloud安装证据。
detail.en: The queried scope contains no sufficient evidence of an official iCloud installation.

detail.zh-Hans: 来源未核实或不满足要求；用户显选公共备选仍不判就绪。
detail.en: The source is unverified or does not meet requirements; an explicitly selected public fallback is still not ready.

detail.en: No game or selected-package budget is available, so sufficient target-volume space cannot be confirmed.

detail.en: The probe could not finish because of permissions, timeout, output, or requirement-format problems; availability is not confirmed.

detail.zh-Hans: 任务中途失败，原因见诊断。
detail.en: The job failed partway; see the diagnostics.

title.zh-Hans: 会让别的游戏暂时不能玩
title.en: Other games would stop working for now

detail.zh-Hans: 手机上有几款游戏是在另一台电脑上装的，这台电脑没法把它们一起放进新的 App。
detail.en: Some games on the phone were installed from another computer, and this computer can't put them into the new app.

detail.zh-Hans: 游戏开着的时候换存档，存档会被游戏写坏。
detail.en: Changing saves while the game is open lets the game overwrite and damage them.

title.en: Saves could not be backed up first

detail.zh-Hans: 这次装机前没能把手机上的存档备份到电脑。存档没备份，万一覆盖出问题可能丢档；确认仍然继续就照装。
detail.en: Your saves on the phone could not be backed up to this computer before installing. Without a backup, a problem during the overwrite could lose saves; confirm to install anyway.

title.zh-Hans: 会撤掉一张已有的开发证书
title.en: An existing development certificate will be revoked

detail.zh-Hans: 账号证书满了时，新建证书会让苹果撤掉列表里的第一张。在 AltStore / SideStore 上创建的那张就是它们在用的证书，撤掉后 AltStore / SideStore 和它们装的 App 会打不开。
detail.en: If your account's certificates are full, creating a new one makes Apple revoke the first one in the list. If it was created on AltStore / SideStore, it is the certificate they are using: once it is revoked, AltStore / SideStore and the apps they installed stop opening.

title.zh-Hans: 会顶掉手机上的另一个 App
title.en: This will replace another app on the device

detail.zh-Hans: 你的描述文件只允许一个包名，装这款会替换手机上同包名的那个 App，被替换的就打不开了；它的存档留在手机上，以后换回来接着能玩。
detail.en: Your provisioning profile allows only one bundle ID, so installing this game replaces the app with the same ID on the device and that app stops opening. Its saves stay on the device and come back if you switch back.

detail.zh-Hans: 手机报的空闲空间比这次要传的少。它不含系统随时能清掉的空间，实际多半放得下；仍然继续就照传，真写满了会停下并说明还差多少。
detail.en: The free space the iPhone reports is less than this transfer needs. It leaves out space iOS can clear at any time, so it usually still fits; continue to send anyway, and it stops and says how much is missing only if storage really fills up.

title.zh-Hans: 要先重新出 iPhone 版

detail.zh-Hans: 同一个 S2Arm App 里的游戏要用同一版 S2Arm 出：有的游戏还是旧版出的，或者这台电脑上没有它的 iPhone 版。
detail.en: Games in the same S2Arm app must be built by the same S2Arm version: some were built by an older one, or this computer has no iPhone build of them.

detail.zh-Hans: 这款游戏的程序文件和游戏包对不上，可能是游戏文件被改过或混了别的游戏。
detail.en: This game's program files do not match its game package. The files may have been modified or mixed with another game.

detail.zh-Hans: 这款和手机上已有的游戏地址空间类型不同。
detail.en: This game uses a different address space type from the games already on the iPhone.

detail.zh-Hans: 这款已从 App 里移除，但它在手机上的数据还在。
detail.en: The game was removed from the app, but its data is still on the iPhone.

detail.zh-Hans: 第一次签名要在 Mac 屏幕上允许使用开发证书。
detail.en: The first signing needs you to allow use of the development certificate on the Mac's screen.

detail.zh-Hans: Windows 上这款游戏的文件路径超过了系统限制。
detail.en: A file path for this game exceeds the Windows limit.

title.zh-Hans: Windows 的强制 ASLR 开着

detail.zh-Hans: 出包工具起不了子进程。
detail.en: The packing tools can't start child processes.

detail.zh-Hans: 没找到这款的资源包目录，没有装到 iPhone。
detail.en: The resource pack folder for this game was not found; nothing was installed on the iPhone.

title.zh-Hans: 系统能给 App 的地址范围不够这款游戏
title.en: Not enough app address range for this game

detail.zh-Hans: 这款游戏开局要一大块连续的地址范围，这台设备的系统能给 App 的不够（和存储空间无关），可能会非常卡，或一直停在开头。
detail.en: This game needs one large continuous address range at start-up and the system on this device can't give apps enough (this has nothing to do with storage space); it may be very slow or stay at the beginning.

detail.zh-Hans: 这款在电脑上的游戏文件夹被删或挪走了，没有装到 iPhone。
detail.en: This game’s folder on the computer was deleted or moved; nothing was installed on the iPhone.

detail.zh-Hans: 某一步的工具返回了错误。
detail.en: A tool in the pipeline returned an error.

title.zh-Hans: 游戏运行中意外退出了

detail.zh-Hans: 游戏已经开始运行，后来自己退出了（通常是崩溃）。存档停在游戏上次保存的地方。
detail.en: The game started, then quit on its own (usually a crash). Your save is as of the last time the game saved.

title.zh-Hans: 这款需要更多内存，已经记下
title.en: This game needs more memory; it has been noted

detail.zh-Hans: 这款游戏开局要的内存比 S2Arm 预先给的多。已经记下它要多少，再点一次开始就能进；存档不受影响。
detail.en: This game needs more memory at startup than S2Arm set aside. How much it needs has been noted, so start it again and it will run. Your saves are not affected.

title.zh-Hans: 游戏卡住了，已经安全停下
title.en: The game got stuck and was stopped safely

detail.zh-Hans: 游戏运行中卡住了，S2Arm 把这局安全停下，免得整台电脑跟着卡死。存档停在游戏上次保存的地方。
detail.en: The game got stuck while running. S2Arm stopped this session safely so the whole Mac wouldn't freeze. Your save is as of the last time the game saved.

detail.zh-Hans: 没有找到解开游戏内容的密钥。
detail.en: No usable keys were found for this game.

detail.zh-Hans: 密钥文件和这款游戏对不上。
detail.en: The key file does not match this game.

detail.zh-Hans: 没有找到内容对应的票据或标题密钥。
detail.en: The ticket or title key for this content is missing.

detail.zh-Hans: 部分内容超出文件末尾。
detail.en: Some content extends past the end of the file.

detail.zh-Hans: 缺少读取该文件所需的密钥。
detail.en: The keys needed to read this file are missing.

detail.zh-Hans: 无法解密或验证这份游戏内容。
detail.en: This game content could not be decrypted or verified.

detail.zh-Hans: 只能导入 NSP / XCI 等游戏文件。
detail.en: Only NSP / XCI and similar game files can be imported.

detail.zh-Hans: 选中的文件没有内容。
detail.en: The selected file has no content.

detail.zh-Hans: 选的原件不是这一款，这款的记录没有改动。
detail.en: The file you picked is not this game, so nothing was changed.

detail.zh-Hans: 选中的游戏文件已不在原处。
detail.en: The selected game file is no longer where it was.

title.zh-Hans: 没有读取游戏文件的权限
title.en: No permission to read the game file

detail.zh-Hans: 系统没有允许本应用读取游戏文件所在的位置。
detail.en: macOS has not allowed this app to read the location of the game file.

detail.zh-Hans: 游戏文件在原处，但读取时出错。
detail.en: The game file is there, but reading it failed.

detail.zh-Hans: 只导入了更新或 DLC，没有随附本体。
detail.en: Only an update or DLC was imported; the base game is missing.

detail.zh-Hans: 这款游戏是 32 位 ARM 程序。
detail.en: This game is a 32-bit ARM program.

detail.zh-Hans: 文件结构校验没通过，可能没下完整。
detail.en: The file structure did not validate; the copy may be incomplete.

title.zh-Hans: 游戏库所在磁盘格式不支持

detail.zh-Hans: 游戏原件放哪块盘都行；导出时的工作数据（游戏库）要放在 APFS 或 exFAT 格式的磁盘上，FAT32 等格式不适合做游戏库。
detail.en: Game files can stay on any drive; the working data for exporting (the game library) must be on an APFS or exFAT drive. FAT32 and similar formats are not suitable for the library.

detail.zh-Hans: 有一步很久没有任何进展，S2Arm 已把它停下。
detail.en: One step made no progress for a long time, so S2Arm stopped it.

detail.zh-Hans: 出包时内存用完了。
detail.en: This computer ran out of memory while exporting.

title.zh-Hans: 存放位置所在磁盘格式不支持

detail.zh-Hans: 这块盘不支持出包需要的文件操作（常见于 exFAT / FAT 格式的外接盘）。
detail.en: This drive does not support the file operations exporting needs (common on exFAT / FAT external drives).

title.zh-Hans: 游戏库在云盘同步目录里
title.en: Library is in a cloud-synced folder

detail.zh-Hans: 游戏库要放在本机磁盘上不同步的位置；云盘同步目录（iCloud 云盘、OneDrive、Dropbox 等）里出包会读不到中间文件。游戏原件放在哪都行。
detail.en: The game library must be in a local folder that is not synced. Exports fail inside cloud-synced folders (iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and similar). Game files can stay anywhere.

title.en: This folder holds a different game library

detail.zh-Hans: 文件夹里的游戏库和 S2Arm 记下的不是同一个（从备份恢复、从别处拷来，或重装后记录丢了都会这样）。
detail.en: The library in this folder isn’t the one S2Arm remembered (restored from a backup, copied from elsewhere, or the record was lost after reinstalling).

title.zh-Hans: 文件夹里已有别的文件
title.en: This folder already has other files

detail.zh-Hans: S2Arm 只在自己建的文件和子文件夹里读写，不改也不删这个文件夹里原有的文件；以后搬游戏库时它们会一起搬走。
detail.en: S2Arm only reads and writes the files and subfolders it creates, and never changes or deletes the files already here. If you move the library later, they move with it.

title.zh-Hans: 这块盘可以用，但不是 NTFS
title.en: This drive works, but it isn't NTFS

detail.zh-Hans: exFAT / FAT32 的盘可以放游戏库，但出包会多占空间，FAT32 上超过 4 GB 的游戏出不了。放在 NTFS 盘上更省空间。
detail.en: exFAT / FAT32 drives can hold the library, but exports take more space, and games over 4 GB can't be exported on FAT32. An NTFS drive saves space.

title.zh-Hans: FAT32 盘放不下这款的资源包
title.en: This game's resources don't fit on a FAT32 drive

detail.zh-Hans: iPhone 资源包是一个大文件，FAT32 盘单个文件最多 4 GB。
detail.en: The iPhone resources are one large file, and a FAT32 drive allows at most 4 GB per file.

detail.zh-Hans: 搬家过程中出了问题，游戏库保持在原来的位置。
detail.en: Something went wrong during the move. The library stays where it was.

detail.zh-Hans: 这一批停在这里，已出好的包都在。
detail.en: The batch stopped here; finished games are kept.

title.zh-Hans: 另一个任务正在使用游戏库
title.en: Another task is using the library

detail.zh-Hans: 等它结束再试，这次什么都没有改动。
detail.en: Wait for it to finish, then try again. Nothing was changed.

title.en: The library lock is still held

detail.zh-Hans: 原任务进程已不在，但游戏库的锁仍被占用。重新连接或重新挂载游戏库所在磁盘后再试；不要手动删除锁文件。本次没有改动游戏文件。
detail.en: The original task process is gone, but the library lock is still held. Reconnect or remount the library drive and retry. Do not delete the lock file; no game files were changed.

title.zh-Hans: 下游方案只能装到 iPhone
title.en: This port can only be installed on iPhone

detail.zh-Hans: 这款选了下游深度方案（独立 App），它的资源要由电脑推进手机，导出的自签包里装不下。
detail.en: This game uses a dedicated port (a separate app). Its resources are copied to the phone from your computer, so they can't go into an exported self-sign package.

title.zh-Hans: 这一版更新用不了这个方案
title.en: This update cannot use this route

detail.zh-Hans: 下游方案只支持某一版更新，导入的不是那一版。
detail.en: The downstream route supports one update version only, and the imported one is different.

detail.zh-Hans: 本机打包诊断太慢（和网络无关），或上传服务没开通、连不上、没收下这份诊断包。
detail.en: Packing the diagnostics on this computer took too long (not a network problem), or the upload service is not available, could not be reached, or did not accept this package.

detail.zh-Hans: 需要的文件没下载下来，或下载的内容和登记的不一致。
detail.en: A needed file did not download, or what downloaded does not match what is registered.

detail.zh-Hans: 出包最后核对资源包时，有文件前后两次读出的内容对不上。多见于磁盘或内存读写不稳定，或有杀毒、云同步软件在改游戏库里的文件。
detail.en: When checking the resource pack at the end of packaging, some files read back differently from before. This usually means unstable disk or memory reads, or antivirus or cloud sync software changing files in the game library.

title.en: This drive had a read/write error

detail.zh-Hans: 系统报告硬件或连接故障。
detail.en: The system reported a hardware or connection fault.

detail.zh-Hans: 准备这个游戏需要更多空余空间。
detail.en: Preparing this game needs more free space.

title.zh-Hans: 连不上 {0} 的开发者通道

detail.zh-Hans: 电脑连不上这台 {0} 的开发者通道，没能装上。
detail.en: This Mac couldn't reach the {0}'s developer connection, so nothing was installed.

detail.zh-Hans: 系统拒绝了这次文件访问。
detail.en: The system denied this file access.

detail.zh-Hans: Windows 的应用控制或杀毒软件没让 S2Arm 自带的工具运行。
detail.en: Windows app control or antivirus stopped one of S2Arm's own tools from running.

detail.zh-Hans: 这条路径只能在 Apple Silicon Mac 上跑。
detail.en: This path runs only on Apple Silicon Macs.

detail.zh-Hans: 当前游戏路径要求 macOS 15 或更新。
detail.en: This game's path needs macOS 15 or newer.

detail.zh-Hans: 编译着色器要用 Xcode 的命令行工具。
detail.en: Compiling shaders needs Xcode's command-line tools.

detail.zh-Hans: Xcode 首次使用前要先同意许可。
detail.en: Xcode must be accepted once before first use.

detail.zh-Hans: 编着色器要用的 Metal 组件没装上。
detail.en: The Metal component needed for shader compilation is not installed.

detail.zh-Hans: 连不上苹果的组件服务器，Metal 编译组件下载不下来。
detail.en: Apple's component server can't be reached, so the Metal compiler component can't be downloaded.

title.zh-Hans: 缺少 iOS 平台组件

detail.zh-Hans: Xcode 的 iOS 平台还没装，打不了 iPhone 包。
detail.en: Xcode's iOS platform is not installed, so iPhone packages cannot be built.

title.zh-Hans: iOS 平台组件还没注册

detail.zh-Hans: 组件已经下载，只是还没注册到模拟器。
detail.en: The platform is downloaded but not registered with the simulator yet.

detail.zh-Hans: 应用自带的 .NET 运行时不在了。
detail.en: The .NET runtime bundled with the app is missing.

detail.zh-Hans: 给 iPhone 出包要用 .NET 10 SDK。
detail.en: Bundling for iPhone needs the .NET 10 SDK.

detail.zh-Hans: 解包器读不动这份文件里的某一段。
detail.en: The unpacker cannot read part of this file.

title.zh-Hans: 这版 S2Arm 不认识你的 Xcode
title.en: This S2Arm version does not recognize your Xcode

detail.zh-Hans: 你的 Xcode 比这版 S2Arm 新。
detail.en: Your Xcode is newer than this S2Arm version.

title.zh-Hans: 这款游戏暂时出不了包
title.en: This game can't be packed yet

detail.zh-Hans: 没认出它用的图形接口（NVN / Vulkan / OpenGL）。请把诊断发给我们，我们会核对是不是没认出来。
detail.en: We couldn't identify which graphics API it uses (NVN / Vulkan / OpenGL). Please send us a diagnostic so we can check whether we missed it.

title.en: This game is not supported yet

detail.zh-Hans: 出包工具还没适配这款游戏的程序结构。请把诊断发给我们，我们按它补上。
detail.en: The packer doesn't handle how this game's program is built yet. Please send us a diagnostic and we'll add support.

detail.zh-Hans: 应用自带的引擎文件缺失。
detail.en: Engine files bundled with the app are missing.

detail.zh-Hans: 这一版的安卓出包还在开关后面，没对玩家开放。
detail.en: Android export in this version is still behind a switch and not open to players.

detail.zh-Hans: 装到安卓手机要用 adb，从 Google 官方地址下载没成功。
detail.en: Installing on an Android phone needs adb, and downloading it from Google failed.

detail.zh-Hans: 列出已连接的安卓手机时 adb 报错。
detail.en: adb reported an error while listing connected Android phones.

detail.zh-Hans: 这条链上有个工具没装。
detail.en: A tool in this pipeline is not installed.

detail.zh-Hans: 选中的设备不在支持范围内。
detail.en: The selected device is outside the supported range.

detail.zh-Hans: 这套工具链要求更新的 Xcode。
detail.en: This toolchain needs a newer Xcode.

detail.zh-Hans: 缺运行需要的组件。
detail.en: A component the runtime needs is missing.

title.zh-Hans: 这台 Mac 还没有签名团队
title.en: No signing team on this Mac yet

detail.zh-Hans: Apple ID 已经登录，但这台 Mac 还没有可用的签名团队。
detail.en: Your Apple ID is signed in, but this Mac has no signing team yet.

detail.zh-Hans: Xcode 没能自动创建开发证书。
detail.en: Xcode couldn't create a development certificate automatically.

title.zh-Hans: Xcode 里没登录 Apple ID

detail.zh-Hans: 装到 iPhone 要用你在 Xcode 里登录的 Apple ID 签名。
detail.en: Installing on iPhone signs with the Apple ID you signed in to in Xcode.

detail.zh-Hans: 装到 iPhone 前要先和手机建立开发连接。
detail.en: Installing on iPhone needs a development connection to the device first.

detail.zh-Hans: 你选的那台设备现在连不上：插上数据线，或让它和电脑在同一个 Wi-Fi。
detail.en: The device you chose can't be reached: connect it with a cable, or put it on the same Wi-Fi as this computer.

detail.zh-Hans: 装机要先选好装到哪台 iPhone / iPad。
detail.en: Choose which iPhone or iPad to install to first.

detail.zh-Hans: 用你的 Apple ID 给这台 {0} 签名没成功。
detail.en: Signing for this {0} with your Apple ID did not succeed.

title.zh-Hans: 手机上的游戏文件夹 S2Arm 写不进
title.en: S2Arm can't write to the game folder on the iPhone

detail.zh-Hans: 这个文件夹的归属不对，S2Arm 在里面建不了文件。
detail.en: The folder has the wrong owner, so S2Arm can't create files in it.

title.en: Not enough space on the iPhone

detail.zh-Hans: 写游戏文件时手机存储满了。
detail.en: The iPhone ran out of storage while writing the game files.

title.zh-Hans: 游戏文件是新格式，这版 S2Arm 认不出
title.en: This game file uses a newer format than this S2Arm supports

detail.zh-Hans: 游戏是用更新版的 S2Arm 做的。
detail.en: The game was built with a newer version of S2Arm.

title.zh-Hans: 游戏文件坏了或没传完
title.en: The game file is damaged or incomplete

detail.zh-Hans: game.img 的长度或目录对不上。
detail.en: The length or table of game.img doesn't match.

title.zh-Hans: 游戏文件坏了或没传完
title.en: The game file is damaged or incomplete

detail.zh-Hans: game.img 的长度或目录对不上。
detail.en: The length or table of game.img doesn't match.

title.en: A transfer package didn't arrive complete

detail.zh-Hans: 传输中途断开，留下了半截的包。
detail.en: The transfer was interrupted and left a partial package.

title.zh-Hans: 手机上的游戏文件不全
title.en: Some game files are missing on the iPhone

detail.zh-Hans: 安装后核对时发现缺了文件。
detail.en: Some files were missing when the install was checked.

title.en: The install manifest can't be read

detail.zh-Hans: 随游戏推送的清单文件坏了或不全。
detail.en: The manifest pushed with the game is damaged or incomplete.

detail.zh-Hans: 安装时往手机写文件出错。
detail.en: An error occurred while writing files to the iPhone.

title.zh-Hans: 放进来的游戏文件没能导入
title.en: The game file you added couldn't be imported

detail.zh-Hans: 从「文件」放进来的游戏文件没能装好。
detail.en: The game file added through the Files app couldn't be set up.

title.zh-Hans: 手机上还没有这款游戏，更新包套不上
title.en: This game isn't on the phone yet, so the update can't be applied

detail.zh-Hans: 着色器更新包只换已装好的游戏里的着色器，要先有这款的完整 .img。
detail.en: A shader update only replaces the shaders of a game that's already on the phone; the full .img is needed first.

title.zh-Hans: 更新包和手机上的游戏版本对不上
title.en: The update doesn't match the game version on the phone

detail.zh-Hans: 这个着色器更新包配的是这款游戏的另一个版本，套上会出错，所以没有导入。
detail.en: This shader update is for a different version of the game, so it was not applied.

detail.zh-Hans: 安装没完成，原因没能认出来。
detail.en: The install didn't finish and the reason couldn't be identified.

detail.zh-Hans: 签名和安装要 iPhone 处于解锁状态。
detail.en: Signing and installing need the iPhone to be unlocked.

title.en: S2Arm is not installed on the {0}

detail.zh-Hans: 「推到 iPhone」只推游戏，不装 App；这台 {0} 上还没有 S2Arm。
detail.en: "Push to iPhone" only sends the game and does not install the App; this {0} does not have S2Arm yet.

title.zh-Hans: 这台 {0} 上装着不止一个 S2Arm
title.en: More than one S2Arm on this {0}

detail.zh-Hans: 同一台 {0} 上装着两个及以上 S2Arm（比如 AltStore 装的一个、启动器装的一个），S2Arm 不替你挑推到哪一个。
detail.en: This {0} has two or more S2Arm installed (for example one from AltStore and one from the launcher), and S2Arm won't pick one for you.

title.zh-Hans: 选的 S2Arm 不在 {0} 上了
title.en: The chosen S2Arm is no longer on the {0}

detail.zh-Hans: 选过的那个 S2Arm 已经从这台 {0} 上删掉或换掉了。
detail.en: The S2Arm you chose has been removed from or replaced on this {0}.

title.zh-Hans: {0} 上这个 S2Arm 是独立 App
title.en: This S2Arm on the {0} is a standalone App

detail.zh-Hans: 它只玩自己带的那一款游戏，推别的游戏进去不会出现，所以这次没有推。
detail.en: It only plays the one game it was built with; other games pushed into it would not show up, so nothing was pushed.

title.en: S2Arm on the {0} is an older version

detail.zh-Hans: 这台 {0} 上的 S2Arm 不是这台电脑装的，版本比这个启动器旧：游戏照样能推、能玩，但 App 里的新修复要更新 App 才生效。
detail.en: S2Arm on this {0} was not installed by this computer and is older than this launcher: games can still be pushed and played, but fixes inside the app only take effect after updating it.

title.en: S2Arm on the {0} is too old

detail.zh-Hans: 这台 {0} 上的 S2Arm 不是这台电脑装的，旧到读不了这一版出的游戏程序，推进去也打不开。
detail.en: S2Arm on this {0} was not installed by this computer and is too old to read game programs prepared by this version; they would not open.

title.zh-Hans: 手机上的 S2Arm 要先更新
title.en: S2Arm on the phone needs updating first

detail.zh-Hans: 手机上的 S2Arm 是别的版本，这一版的游戏程序放上去打不开。
detail.en: S2Arm on the phone is a different version, so game programs prepared by this version would not open there.

detail.zh-Hans: 这台 {0} 没连到这台 Mac，账号上也还没登记过它，申请不到能装到它上面的开发描述文件。
detail.en: This {0} isn't connected to this Mac and hasn't been registered to your account yet, so no development profile can be created for it.

title.zh-Hans: 签名工具 Impactor 不在了
title.en: The Impactor signing tool is missing

detail.zh-Hans: S2Arm Windows 版自带的签名工具 Impactor 不在安装目录里，安装包不完整。
detail.en: The Impactor signing tool that ships with S2Arm for Windows is missing from the install folder; the package is incomplete.

detail.zh-Hans: 装的 Impactor 不是实测过的版本。
detail.en: The installed Impactor is not the tested version.

detail.zh-Hans: 登录苹果时账号或密码被拒。
detail.en: Apple rejected the account or password when signing in.

title.zh-Hans: 这款正在升级 S 级优化

detail.zh-Hans: 这款游戏正在升级 S 级优化，升级完成前不能开始；别的游戏照常能玩。
detail.en: This game is upgrading its S-Grade optimization and can't start until it finishes. Other games can be played as usual.

detail.zh-Hans: Apple 拒绝了输入的两步验证码。
detail.en: Apple rejected the two-factor verification code.

title.zh-Hans: 苹果拒绝了这台电脑的登录

detail.zh-Hans: 登录后半段苹果不认这台电脑的设备身份（错误码 -80046）。
detail.en: Apple did not accept this computer’s device identity after the password step (error -80046).

detail.zh-Hans: 侧载工具读不了这个旧版包。
detail.en: The sideload tool cannot read this older package.

title.zh-Hans: 这台 {0} 的自签 App 装满了
title.en: Self-signed app limit reached on this {0}

detail.zh-Hans: 免费 Apple ID 在每台设备上最多同时装 3 个自签 App。
detail.en: A free Apple ID can have at most 3 self-signed apps installed on a device at the same time.

title.zh-Hans: 连不上签名用的服务器

detail.zh-Hans: Impactor 签名前要连登录辅助服务器 mac-ani.jkcoxson.com，这台电脑连不上（域名解析或连接失败）。
detail.en: Before signing, Impactor contacts the sign-in helper server mac-ani.jkcoxson.com, and this computer cannot reach it (name lookup or connection failed).

detail.zh-Hans: 保存的 Apple ID 登录过期了（Apple 错误 1100），要在 Impactor 里重新登录。
detail.en: The saved Apple ID sign-in has expired (Apple error 1100). Sign in again in Impactor.

detail.zh-Hans: 签名用的 Apple ID 还没登录或没选中（从没登录过，或存了几个却没选中），签名前要先登录。
detail.en: No Apple ID is selected for signing (never signed in, or several saved but none selected). Sign in before signing.

detail.zh-Hans: 登录 Apple ID 或签名时连不上苹果的服务器（域名解析或连接失败），不是 Apple ID 的问题。
detail.en: Could not reach Apple's servers while signing in or signing (name lookup or connection failed). This is not a problem with your Apple ID.

detail.zh-Hans: 登录 Apple ID 时苹果的服务器回了「服务暂不可用」（HTTP 5xx），还没到核对账号密码这一步，不是网络或 Apple ID 的问题。
detail.en: While you were signing in to your Apple ID, Apple's server answered "service unavailable" (HTTP 5xx) before checking your account. This is not a problem with your network or your Apple ID.

title.zh-Hans: 没读到开发者证书设置
title.en: Developer certificate settings could not be read

detail.zh-Hans: 这台电脑拒绝 S2Arm 读它自己的证书设置文件夹，这次按 Apple ID 签名。
detail.en: This computer denied S2Arm access to its own certificate settings folder, so this time it signed with your Apple ID.

title.zh-Hans: 包名在苹果那边已被占用

detail.zh-Hans: 苹果拒绝注册这个包名（Apple 错误 9401）。
detail.en: Apple refused to register this App ID (Apple error 9401).

title.zh-Hans: 手机上的 S2Arm 是用别的签名装的
title.en: S2Arm on the iPhone has a different signature

detail.zh-Hans: 包名相同、签名不同，系统不让覆盖安装。
detail.en: Same app ID, different signer: iOS won't install over it.

title.en: Part of this update was not completed

detail.zh-Hans: 「更新这款」这次有一部分没做成，原因写在下面；「建议更新」会继续显示，按说明处理后再点一次。
detail.en: "Update this game" could not finish everything this time; the reason is below. "Update suggested" will keep showing until you follow it and click again.

title.zh-Hans: 分发证书签的通用 S2Arm 打不开游戏
title.en: Games won't open in S2Arm signed with a distribution certificate

detail.zh-Hans: 证书缺调试权限（get-task-allow），改用「独立 App」出法就能玩。
detail.en: The certificate lacks get-task-allow; switch to Standalone App to play.

title.zh-Hans: 描述文件只有一个包名
title.en: The profile allows only one app ID

detail.zh-Hans: 每款独立 App 和通用 S2Arm 都装成同一个包名，装一个会顶掉另一个。
detail.en: Every standalone app and S2Arm install under the same app ID, so each replaces the other.

title.zh-Hans: 免费 Apple ID 的 App 数量有限

detail.zh-Hans: 同时最多 3 个自签 App、7 天最多 10 个 App ID，独立 App 每款占一个。
detail.en: Up to 3 self-signed apps at once and 10 App IDs per 7 days; each standalone app uses one.

title.zh-Hans: 存档已从旧 App 复制过来
title.en: Save copied from the old app

detail.zh-Hans: 新装的独立 App 里没有这款的存档，已从手机上另一个 S2Arm 复制过来，那边的存档没动。
detail.en: The new standalone app had no save for this game, so it was copied from another S2Arm on the phone; the save there was left untouched.

title.zh-Hans: 几个 App 都有这款的存档
title.en: Several apps have a save for this game

detail.zh-Hans: 手机上几个 S2Arm 都存着这款的存档，没替你挑。
detail.en: Several S2Arm apps on the phone have a save for this game, so none was picked for you.

title.zh-Hans: 旧存档缺索引，没有复制
title.en: Old save is missing its index, not copied

detail.zh-Hans: 另一个 S2Arm 里有这款的存档，但缺存档索引或用户档案，拷过去游戏也认不出。
detail.en: Another S2Arm has a save for this game, but its save index or user profile is missing, so the game wouldn't recognize a copy.

title.zh-Hans: 新 App 已有存档，未覆盖
title.en: New app already has a save, not overwritten

detail.zh-Hans: 旧进度还在另一个 S2Arm 里，没有覆盖新 App 里的存档。
detail.en: The old progress is still in another S2Arm; the save in the new app was not overwritten.

title.en: Save copy interrupted and rolled back

detail.zh-Hans: 从另一个 S2Arm 复制这款的存档时中断，新 App 里没留下半份。
detail.en: Copying this game's save from another S2Arm was interrupted; nothing half-copied was left in the new app.

title.en: Installed under a new app ID

detail.zh-Hans: 原包名被别的签名用过，这次换成新包名装好了。
detail.en: The old app ID was taken by another signature, so a new one was used.

title.zh-Hans: 手机不认这次签名用的证书
title.en: The device rejected the signing certificate

detail.zh-Hans: 手机说这次签名用的开发证书已失效：别的工具新建或撤销过证书，或手机日期时间不对。
detail.en: The device says the development certificate used for signing is no longer valid: another tool created or revoked certificates, or the device date and time are wrong.

title.zh-Hans: 免费 Apple ID 的包名额度用完了
title.en: Free Apple ID App ID limit reached

detail.zh-Hans: Apple 规定免费 Apple ID 7 天内最多注册 10 个包名（Apple 错误 9120），删掉手机上的 App 不会释放额度。
detail.en: Apple lets a free Apple ID register at most 10 App IDs in 7 days (Apple error 9120). Deleting apps from the iPhone does not free up the quota.

detail.zh-Hans: 密码不对，或 .p12 文件坏了。
detail.en: The password is wrong, or the .p12 file is damaged.

detail.zh-Hans: 粘进来的不是一串完整的 S2Arm 诊断码。
detail.en: The pasted text isn't a complete S2Arm diagnostic code.

detail.zh-Hans: 选的文件不是 .p12 证书或 iOS 描述文件。
detail.en: The chosen file is not a .p12 certificate or an iOS provisioning profile.

title.zh-Hans: 证书和描述文件不配套

detail.zh-Hans: 描述文件里没有这张证书，签出来装不上。
detail.en: The profile doesn't include this certificate, so a signed app won't install.

title.zh-Hans: 这是分发证书的描述文件

detail.zh-Hans: 通用 S2Arm 的游戏程序在 App 外加载，用分发证书签的通用 S2Arm 打不开游戏；独立 App（一个 App 一款游戏）照常能玩。
detail.en: In the S2Arm app, game code loads outside the app, so games won't open when it's signed with a distribution certificate; standalone apps (one app per game) work as usual.

title.zh-Hans: 这台电脑上没有可交的签名证书
title.en: No signing certificate to hand over on this computer

detail.zh-Hans: 启动器不会为此新建证书，以免让 AltStore 或 SideStore 的证书失效。
detail.en: The launcher won't create a new certificate for this, so the certificate AltStore or SideStore is using stays valid.

title.zh-Hans: 手机上的 S2Arm 不是这个团队签的
title.en: S2Arm on the phone was signed by a different team

detail.zh-Hans: 装 S2Arm 用的 Apple ID 或证书，和这台电脑上的不是同一个团队。
detail.en: The Apple ID or certificate used to install S2Arm is from a different team than the one on this computer.

detail.zh-Hans: 证书、描述文件或密码缺了一样。
detail.en: The certificate, profile, or password is missing.

title.zh-Hans: 证书密码没存进钥匙串
title.en: Couldn't save the certificate password to the keychain

detail.zh-Hans: 钥匙串拒绝或被锁。
detail.en: The keychain refused the request or is locked.

title.en: Choose a certificate for this device

detail.zh-Hans: 存着几张开发者证书，不知道这台用哪一张。
detail.en: Several developer certificates are saved, and none is chosen for this device.

title.zh-Hans: 已重新打开上次崩溃时关掉的设置
title.en: Turned back on what was switched off after a crash

detail.zh-Hans: 上次游戏崩溃时自动关掉的补丁 / 金手指，新版 S2Arm 已重新打开。
detail.en: Patches or cheats that were switched off after a crash are back on in this version of S2Arm.

detail.zh-Hans: 这款的程序件里混进了大文件（正常不到 50 MB），出包照常完成。
detail.en: A large file ended up in this game's program files (normally under 50 MB). Packaging still finished.

detail.zh-Hans: 有追加内容没解出，本体照常出好，包里不含这部分。
detail.en: Some add-on content could not be extracted; the base game was still packaged, without that content.

detail.zh-Hans: 这款的着色器离线预编 0 支，游戏能玩，但首次遇到的画面要现编，开头会卡顿。
detail.en: No shaders could be prebuilt for this game. It still runs, but each new scene compiles its shaders the first time, so expect stutter early on.

title.zh-Hans: 没能复用另一平台准备好的数据
title.en: Could not reuse the other platform's prepared data

detail.zh-Hans: 游戏库所在的磁盘不支持克隆，本次从解包目录重新准备。
detail.en: The game library's disk does not support cloning, so this export prepared the data again from the unpacked game.

title.zh-Hans: 包签名丢了提高内存上限权限

detail.zh-Hans: 这台机上装的包签名里没有提高内存上限权限，大游戏容易被系统杀。
detail.en: The app installed on this device is signed without the increased memory limit entitlement; large games may be killed by the system.

title.zh-Hans: 旧的导出文件夹被占用，这次换了个名字
title.en: The old export folder was in use, so a new name was used

detail.zh-Hans: 原来的导出文件夹正被别的程序打开着，这次导出放到了带时间的新文件夹里。
detail.en: Another program had the old export folder open, so this export went into a new folder with the time in its name.

title.zh-Hans: 资源包已传完，请在 {0} 上打开游戏
title.en: Resources copied; open the game on your {0}

detail.zh-Hans: 电脑这边打不开 {0} 上的 App，资源包本身已完整传到设备上。
detail.en: This computer could not open the app on the {0}. The resource pack itself was copied completely.

detail.zh-Hans: 这台 {0} 按 USB 2.0（480 Mb/s）连着，资源包拷得慢；USB 3 能快约 10 倍。
detail.en: This {0} is connected at USB 2.0 (480 Mb/s), so copying the resource pack is slow; USB 3 is about 10x faster.

title.zh-Hans: 游戏文件和原版有出入，已照常导入
title.en: Game file differs from the original; imported anyway

detail.zh-Hans: 这份文件里有数据和原版对不上（多半是改版 / 整合版，或个别块损坏），已跳过完整性校验照常导入。
detail.en: Some data in this file does not match the original (usually a modded or merged build, or a damaged block). The integrity check was skipped and the game was imported anyway.

title.en: Home Screen widget not installed this time

detail.zh-Hans: S2Arm 已照常装好，只是这次没带主屏小组件，原因见上。
detail.en: S2Arm is installed as usual; only the Home Screen widget was left out this time. The reason is shown above.

title.zh-Hans: 包用的 Xcode 比 iPhone 系统旧
title.en: Package built with an older Xcode than the iPhone's iOS

detail.zh-Hans: 这个包用旧版 Xcode 出，iPhone Duo 等新机型上整个 App 会缩小在屏幕中间。
detail.en: This package was built with an older Xcode; on newer models such as iPhone Duo the whole app is shown shrunk in the middle of the screen.

detail.zh-Hans: IPA 或资源包的产物账本校验没通过，原产物保留。
detail.en: The IPA or resource-pack artifact record failed validation; the previous artifacts are kept.

detail.zh-Hans: 配置推导失败；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Configuration inference failed. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 着色器抽取失败；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Shader extraction failed. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 编译失败；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Compilation failed. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 程序改写失败；具体原因见本任务的错误摘要。
detail.en: Program rewriting failed. See this job’s error summary for the specific reason.

detail.zh-Hans: 当前版本没有变化。
detail.en: Your current version was not changed.

detail.zh-Hans: 这款游戏里有程序代码我们的改写器还不支持，我们正在修。
detail.en: This game uses code our rewriter doesn't support yet. We're working on a fix.

detail.zh-Hans: 这款游戏的着色器编译目前只能在 Mac 上完成。
detail.en: Shader compilation for this game is currently only available on Mac.

prompts.note: 游戏内横幅（iOS / Mac 游戏窗口）与启动器共用同一份措辞，改这里要同步那个头文件，字面必须逐字一致。

items.zh-Hans: 当前磁盘不能安全保存：请把游戏库挪到本机磁盘。保存过程中强退，可能留下写了一半的存档。
items.en: This disk can't save safely: move the game library to this Mac's disk. Force-quitting while saving may leave a half-written save.

items.zh-Hans: 当前存储不能安全保存：保存过程中强退，可能留下写了一半的存档。请等游戏存完再退出。
items.en: This storage can't save safely: force-quitting while saving may leave a half-written save. Wait for the game to finish saving before you quit.

items.zh-Hans: 这局先用默认键位照常开始（%s）。回到 S2Arm 的按键设置里重新保存一次就能恢复。
items.en: This game starts with the default buttons (%s). Save your button settings again in S2Arm to restore them.

items.zh-Hans: 要点游戏自己的菜单，就切到触屏，只这一局有效；想一直用触屏去设置里改。左上角齿轮 → 显示按键，随时可以切回按键。
items.en: To tap the game's own menus, switch to touch. This lasts for this session only; to always use touch, change it in Settings. You can switch back to buttons anytime from the gear in the top-left corner → Show Buttons.

items.zh-Hans: 按 A 退出，按 B 回到游戏。退出前会等游戏把存档写完；没在游戏里存的进度会丢。
items.en: Press A to quit or B to return to the game. Quitting waits for the game to finish writing its save; progress you haven't saved in the game will be lost.

items.zh-Hans: 已切到触屏操作：这款游戏用触屏点菜单。左上角齿轮 → 显示按键，可以切回按键。
items.en: Switched to touch controls: this game uses touch for its menus. You can switch back to buttons from the gear in the top-left corner → Show Buttons.
End this game and return to the library

items.zh-Hans: S2Arm 会关闭，再点开就回到游戏库。
items.en: S2Arm closes; open it again to return to the game library.

items.zh-Hans: 请先在游戏里存档。确认后这局结束、S2Arm 关闭，再点开 S2Arm 就回到游戏库，选另一款开始。退出前会等游戏把存档写完；没在游戏里存的进度会丢。
items.en: Save in the game first. When you confirm, this game ends and S2Arm closes; open S2Arm again to return to the game library and pick another game. Quitting waits for the game to finish writing its save; progress you haven't saved in the game will be lost.

items.zh-Hans: 这一局跑不稳 60 帧，已先回到原生帧率；下次开游戏会重新从 60 帧开始。
items.en: This session can't hold 60 FPS steadily, so the game is back at its native frame rate for now. It starts at 60 FPS again the next time you open the game.

items.zh-Hans: 改回 60 帧，本局不再自动降
items.en: Back to 60 FPS, no auto-drop this session

items.zh-Hans: 这款游戏开 60 帧会加速，已保持 30 帧。
items.en: This game runs too fast at 60 FPS, so it stays at 30 FPS.

items.zh-Hans: 游戏想用麦克风，但 S2Arm 没有麦克风权限，游戏只会收到静音。可到「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 麦克风」打开 S2Arm，重开游戏后生效。
items.en: The game wants the microphone, but S2Arm has no microphone permission, so the game only hears silence. Turn on S2Arm in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone, then reopen the game.

items.zh-Hans: 游戏想用麦克风，但这台电脑上没有能用的收音设备，游戏只会收到静音。
items.en: The game wants the microphone, but no usable input device was found on this computer, so the game only hears silence.

items.zh-Hans: 这款游戏的图形组件不完整。在电脑上用启动器重新出包并推送到手机就能解决。
items.en: This game's graphics data is incomplete. Export it again on your computer and send it to your iPhone to fix it.

init_fail_page.note: iOS 人手局初启失败停在提示页（审计 #1534 P1-4）。上屏只放玩家话术：标题 + 按错误码映射的一句原因 + 下一步；内部摘要、错误码 id、构建号、翻译链、红行只进「复制诊断」的诊断文本（11-02 维护者：内部词不上屏）。游戏进程不读本文件，头文件的宏是实现来源，字面必须逐字一致；codes 与头文件 S2A_INIT_FAIL_CODES 一一对应，码表外的码按 unknown 用通用句。

items.zh-Hans: 请从后台划掉本 App 再打开；仍不行请点「复制诊断」把诊断发给我们。
items.en: Swipe this app away in the app switcher and open it again. If it still fails, tap "Copy diagnostics" and send it to us.

items.zh-Hans: 游戏需要的系统功能没能准备好。
items.en: System features the game needs couldn't be prepared.

items.zh-Hans: 本 App 没能准备好运行游戏。
items.en: This app couldn't get ready to run the game.

items.zh-Hans: 游戏程序没能开始运行。
items.en: The game program couldn't start running.

items.zh-Hans: 游戏文件缺失，请重新导入：在 电脑上的 S2Arm 里对这款游戏再点一次「推到 iPhone」。
items.en: Game files are missing. Import them again: in S2Arm on your computer, choose "Push to iPhone" for this game again.

items.zh-Hans: 这台设备的内存和系统能给 App 的地址范围不够运行这款游戏（和存储空间无关），换一台内存更大的 iPhone / iPad 再试；诊断里有它要多少、这台设备有多少。
items.en: This device doesn't have enough memory and app address range to run this game (this has nothing to do with storage space). Try an iPhone or iPad with more memory; the diagnostics show how much it needs and how much this device has.

items.zh-Hans: 系统不允许运行这款游戏的代码：这款游戏程序的签名不被系统认可。请在电脑上的 S2Arm 对这款游戏点「推到 iPhone」重新安装后再打开。
items.en: The system won't let this game's code run: the signature on this game's program isn't accepted. In S2Arm on your computer, choose "Push to iPhone" for this game to reinstall it, then open it again.

items.zh-Hans: 系统不允许运行这款游戏的代码：没取到可用的 LiveContainer 证书。请在 LiveContainer 的设置里重新导入证书后再打开。
items.en: The system won't let this game's code run: no usable LiveContainer certificate was found. Import the certificate again in LiveContainer's settings, then open it again.

items.zh-Hans: 安装这个 S2Arm 用的证书缺「调试权限（get-task-allow）」，没有它系统不让游戏运行。请找证书发放人要含这项权限的 Apple Development 开发证书和开发描述文件（在电脑上的 S2Arm 导入证书时会列出全部缺项，并给出可直接复制给发放人的话），或在电脑上的 S2Arm 改用 Apple ID 登录后重新安装。
items.en: The certificate used to install this S2Arm is missing the debugging entitlement (get-task-allow), and without it iOS won't let games run. Ask whoever issued the certificate for an Apple Development certificate and development provisioning profile that include it (importing the certificate in S2Arm on your computer lists everything that's missing and gives you a message to send them), or sign in with an Apple ID in S2Arm on your computer and install again.

items.zh-Hans: 这款需要更多内存，已经记下，再点一次开始就能进。
items.en: This game needs more memory. It has been noted, so tap Start again and it will run.

items.zh-Hans: 这台设备的图形芯片跑不了 S2Arm（需要 A13 / M1 或更新的芯片）：换一台更新的 iPhone / iPad 再试。
items.en: This device's graphics chip can't run S2Arm (it needs an A13 / M1 or newer chip). Try a newer iPhone or iPad.

selfcheck_page.note: iOS 起局自检不过时的提示页（runtime/src/selfcheck.c s2a_selfcheck_screen）。上屏只放玩家话术：标题 + 一句原因与下一步；地址上限、main.npdm、MB 这类细节只进 host.log（11-02 维护者：内部词不上屏）。判定顺序：NPDM 地址空间类型 0 / 2（32 位，布局只支持 36 / 39 位）→ as_*；没签权限 → ent_*；读不到本款要多大地址 → pkg_*；其余 → device_*。游戏进程不读本文件，头文件的宏是实现来源，字面必须逐字一致；每句带中英文，不复制进 Localizable.json。

items.zh-Hans: 安装少了一项必要权限
这款游戏要用「提高内存上限」权限。请用 电脑上的 S2Arm 点游戏库第一格「S2Arm」里的「续签 S2Arm」重新装一次，会自动带上它。
items.en: This game needs the "Increased Memory Limit" permission. In S2Arm on your computer, click "Renew S2Arm" on the S2Arm card first in the library; it will be included automatically.

items.zh-Hans: 这次安装没带上「提高内存上限」权限，系统给 S2Arm 的内存偏少。可以先点「仍要启动」试着玩，大游戏可能玩到一半被系统结束；想彻底解决，请用 电脑上的 S2Arm 点游戏库第一格「S2Arm」里的「续签 S2Arm」重新装一次，会自动带上它。
items.en: This install is missing the "Increased Memory Limit" permission, so iOS gives S2Arm less memory. You can tap "Start Anyway" to try it; large games may be closed by iOS mid-play. To fix it for good, click "Renew S2Arm" on the S2Arm card first in the library in S2Arm on your computer; the permission will be included automatically.

items.zh-Hans: 这款游戏要用「提高内存上限」权限，这个 App 签名时没带上。请证书发放人在这款的 App ID 上开启它（通配 * 的描述文件开不了，要给这款单独建 App ID），或在 电脑上的 S2Arm 改用 Apple ID 签名，再对这款点「推到 iPhone」重新装一次。
items.en: This game needs the "Increased Memory Limit" permission, and this app was signed without it. Ask whoever issued your certificate to turn it on for this game's App ID (a wildcard * profile can't have it, so the game needs its own App ID), or switch to Apple ID signing in S2Arm on your computer, then click "Push to iPhone" for this game again.

items.zh-Hans: 这次安装没带上「提高内存上限」权限，系统给这款游戏的内存偏少。可以先点「仍要启动」试着玩，大游戏可能玩到一半被系统结束；想彻底解决，请证书发放人在这款的 App ID 上开启它（通配 * 的描述文件开不了，要给这款单独建 App ID），或在 电脑上的 S2Arm 改用 Apple ID 签名，再对这款点「推到 iPhone」重新装一次。
items.en: This install is missing the "Increased Memory Limit" permission, so iOS gives this game less memory. You can tap "Start Anyway" to try it; large games may be closed by iOS mid-play. To fix it for good, ask whoever issued your certificate to turn it on for this game's App ID (a wildcard * profile can't have it, so the game needs its own App ID), or switch to Apple ID signing in S2Arm on your computer, then click "Push to iPhone" for this game again.

items.zh-Hans: 这台设备的系统能给 App 的地址范围不够这款游戏
items.en: The system on this device can't give apps enough address range for this game

items.zh-Hans: 这款游戏开局要一大块连续的地址范围，这台设备的系统能给 App 的不够（和存储空间无关，清理空间没有用）：可能会非常卡，或一直停在开头。可以先点「仍要启动」试试；想正常玩，请换一台内存更大的 iPhone / iPad（系统能给 App 的地址范围更大），或等后续版本改进。
items.en: This game needs one large continuous address range at startup, and the system on this device can't give apps enough (this has nothing to do with storage space; freeing up storage won't help): it may run very slowly or stay stuck at the start. You can tap "Start Anyway" to try; to play normally, use an iPhone or iPad with more memory (their systems can give apps a larger address range), or wait for a later version.

items.zh-Hans: 请在 电脑上的 S2Arm 里对这款游戏再点一次「推到 iPhone」，它会把缺的补上。
items.en: In S2Arm on your computer, click "Push to iPhone" for this game again to add what's missing.

items.zh-Hans: 这台手机暂时玩不了这款游戏
items.en: This iPhone can't run this game yet

items.zh-Hans: 这款游戏要的内存超过了这台手机的系统上限，重新安装也解决不了。换一台内存更大的 iPhone 就能玩。
items.en: This game needs more memory than this iPhone's system limit allows, and reinstalling won't help. It will run on an iPhone with more memory.

items.zh-Hans: 这款游戏使用 32 位地址空间，S2Arm 暂不支持，重新安装或换手机都解决不了。
items.en: This game uses a 32-bit address space, which S2Arm doesn't support yet. Reinstalling or switching phones won't help.

install_landing.note: 装机前清单按钮落点的唯一来源（11-19 落点契约；Mac 与 Windows、作业层、候选验收 landing_check 都读这一处）。actions：动作名 → 按钮文案键（launcher.items 的 id；null = 那一端自画）。items：每端「清单项 id → 没好时该带的 action」；null = 只能人做、不该有按钮（插线 / 解锁）；"@url" = 带官方网页（url 字段）。新加清单项要先在这里登记，pack/jobs/tests/test_landing_contract.py 用后端真实产生的清单核

update_reasons.note: 「建议更新」原因 → 文案键的唯一来源（11-19 结构 9：Mac / Windows 原先各写一份，Windows 缺 libGen、两端都缺 shaderMiss）。后端原因见 pack/jobs/host_update.py；pack/jobs/tests/test_shared_tables.py 核后端会发的原因都在这里。可确认停装码的续跑参数写在 errors 各码的 accept 字段（同一处）

launcher.note: 启动器客户端界面文案（Windows Avalonia 客户端 #1629 起；Mac 新前端可复用）。键 = 客户端界面元素 id，zh-Hans / en 两份必填，客户端按界面语言取，缺键显示 [键名]、不在客户端存副本。环境检查项本身的名称 / 说明 / 下一步与官方页由后端给（pack/jobs/winenv.py checks[].name / message / action / url）；错误码的标题 / 说明用本文件 errors 段。加键：同一提交加 zh-Hans + en，revision +1（README「口径号」规则）。

items.zh-Hans: P12 证书用户强烈推荐
自签 / 一键签名推荐

iPhone 只允许签名里带「调试权限」的 App 运行装在 App 外面的游戏。买来的 P12 大多是分发 / 企业证书，签出来的 App 没有调试权限，游戏只能和 App 打在一起签——所以一款游戏一个 App。一键签名、AltStore / SideStore 自签和开发证书都带调试权限：一个 App 能装所有游戏，随时增删，S2Arm 更新时一般也不用重新出游戏包。你的 P12 如果是开发证书，两种都能用。
items.en: An iPhone only lets an app run games stored outside the app if its signature includes the “debugging” permission. Most P12 certificates you can buy are distribution / enterprise certificates; apps signed with them don’t have that permission, so each game has to be signed inside its own app — one app per game. One-click signing, AltStore / SideStore self-signing and development certificates do include it: one app can hold all your games, you can add or remove games any time, and S2Arm updates usually don’t require rebuilding the games. If your P12 is a development certificate, both options work.

items.zh-Hans:
支持两类 Switch 版 mod，zip 或文件夹都行，可以一次选多个（7z / rar 先解压）。

① 资源替换：换贴图、模型、文字、音乐等，mod 里带 romfs 文件夹。认这几种放法：atmosphere/contents/<程序号>/romfs、<程序号>/<名字>/romfs、<名字>/romfs，或直接选 romfs 文件夹。导入后下次开局生效（iPhone 上要再装一次）。

② 代码补丁：exefs 里的 .pchtxt / .ips（改帧率、分辨率、玩法等），或 atmosphere/exefs_patches 里的 .ips。导入后重新打包这款才生效；补丁按游戏版本分，版本对不上的出包时会跳过。

不收：金手指（有单独入口）、电脑版游戏的 mod、标了别的游戏程序号的 mod。

去哪找：GameBanana（gamebanana.com）资源类 mod 最多；帧率、分辨率补丁多在 GitHub（社区补丁库已自动收录一批，一般不用自己导）；还有各游戏的 Discord、Reddit 社区。认准说明里写 Switch、Ryujinx、Yuzu 或 Atmosphere 的。
items.en:
Two kinds of Switch mods are supported, as a zip or a folder; you can pick several at once (unzip 7z / rar first).

1. Asset replacements: textures, models, text, music and more, in a romfs folder. These layouts are recognized: atmosphere/contents/<title ID>/romfs, <title ID>/<name>/romfs, <name>/romfs, or the romfs folder itself. They take effect the next time the game starts (reinstall on iPhone).

2. Code patches: .pchtxt / .ips in exefs (frame rate, resolution, gameplay and more), or .ips in atmosphere/exefs_patches. Repack the game for them to take effect; patches are made for specific game versions, and ones that don't match are skipped.

Not accepted: cheats (they have their own entry), mods for PC versions of games, and mods marked for another game's title ID.

Where to find mods: GameBanana (gamebanana.com) has the most asset mods; frame rate and resolution patches are mostly on GitHub (the community patch library already includes many, so you usually don't need to import them); also each game's Discord and Reddit communities. Look for mods labeled Switch, Ryujinx, Yuzu or Atmosphere.
